description:
02:18 What is the original Greek word used for "spirit" in Luke 23:46?
Does it refer to an immortal soul, or is it better understood as "breath" returning to God?
Many use this verse to support the idea of a conscious spirit living on after death — but is that really what Jesus meant?

20:18 Pastor Stephen Bohr's study on Matthew 24 raises deep prophetic questions:
Is Matthew 24 presented in full chronological order, or only in part?
Do verses 23–27 suggest that Satan will impersonate Christ after the close of probation? If so, why?
If someone is sealed by the Holy Spirit and receives the Latter Rain, is their probation already closed? Can Satan still tempt them? Is it still possible to fall into sin?

Welcome to I’d Like to Know, a Bible Q&A program on SUMtv, featuring Seventh-day Adventist pastors, including Pastor Stephen Bohr, President of SUMtv, Pastor David Salazar, Pastor CA Murray and Pastor Daniel Miranda. In each episode, we dive into the Scriptures to provide clear, biblically-based answers to your questions, offering spiritual guidance and practical wisdom that align with the teachings of the Adventist Church. Tune in for insights that will help deepen your understanding of God’s Word and prepare for Christ's soon return.
